notes.subject: kamoreng
notes.rationale: החדר: 'kamore' (chamber) vs KJV 'south' — sesotho se latela mongolo wa kamore.

notes.subject: וממזרים
notes.rationale: מזרים ha e hlaha feela mona (peo e le bongata); bohaleng 'ba phallasang' — moya o ka leboya o phallasang maru.

notes.subject: moya o ka leboya
notes.rationale: מזרים ke 'ba phallasang' ka bohaleng; Sesotho se hlalosa e le moya wa leboya.

translation: Ho tloha ⟨ho⟩ kamoreng e tla mokolo, mme ho tloha ho moya o ka leboya ho tla tsereho.

tokens.gloss: mme ho tloha ho moya o ka leboya
